infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used so you can speak task, reminder and finance commands to the assistant.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Used to convert your spoken commands into text for the assistant.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used to scan business cards and receipts to fill in forms for you.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to pick a business card or receipt photo to fill in forms for you.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Used to share your location with family members while the app is open.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Used to keep sharing your location with family members while sharing is turned on, even when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Used to send and relay Bluetooth Chat messages directly between nearby phones, with no internet connection required.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Used so nearby phones can discover your Bluetooth Chat messages, with no internet connection required.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Used to import people from your contacts so you don't have to type them in by hand.
